essence: The sage is Trilocana and the meter is atijagatī.
One should utter the heart-mantra beginning with tārā, O Paramahaṃsinī.
The head-mantra, beginning with dhruvā, is considered the pacifier of severe calamities.
The eye-mantra, beginning with dhruvā, is designated as the rescuer from the ocean of all misfortunes.
After forming the six limb-mantras, one should perform the installation on the faces.
